tools.name: phone_status
tools.description: Check whether the phone is connected, and get its screen size, battery and the app in front.

tools.name: get_screen
tools.description: Read what is on the phone screen as a list of UI elements, each with an [id], text, type, flags and its bounds. Prefer this over screenshot: it is faster and the ids can be used with tap_element and type_text. Ids are only valid until the next get_screen call.

all.description: Include non-interactive layout elements too (default false).

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the phone (JPEG, downscaled). Use when get_screen is not enough, e.g. images, games or canvas apps. The reply states the scale factor to convert image pixels into screen pixels.

tools.name: tap_element
tools.description: Tap a UI element by its id from the last get_screen call.

tools.name: tap
tools.description: Tap at a screen position. Coordinates are real screen pixels (the same units get_screen reports).

tools.name: swipe
tools.description: Swipe from (x1,y1) to (x2,y2). Coordinates are real screen pixels (the same units get_screen reports).

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll the screen (or a scrollable element) up, down, left or right. 'down' shows content further down.

id.description: Optional scrollable element id from get_screen.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Type text into a text field: the element with the given id, otherwise the focused field.

append.description: Add to the existing text instead of replacing it.

submit.description: Press the keyboard's enter/send/search key afterwards.

tools.name: open_app
tools.description: Open an app by its name (e.g. 'Spotify') or package name.

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List installed launchable apps (name and package).

filter.description: Only apps whose name or package contains this.

tools.name: open_url
tools.description: Open a URL or deep link (https:, tel:, geo:, mailto: ...) on the phone.

tools.name: recent_events
tools.description: Show the phone's recent hardware button presses (key codes) and app/screen changes, oldest first, with times.

tools.name: wait
tools.description: Wait a number of seconds (max 20) for something on the phone to load.

instructions: These tools control the user's own Android phone through an accessibility-service app. Usual loop: get_screen -> act (tap_element / type_text / scroll / press_key) -> get_screen to check. Use screenshot only when the element list does not show what you need. Ask the user before sending messages, buying anything, deleting data or changing security settings.
